title: Wat Pa Tam Wua — round 10 (holistic)
notes: Applied r9 + latest edits/highlights. Below are the remaining holistic calls — not nitpicks on single words.

proposals.summary: Bridge mentions science, but science lands later
proposals.before: …once I read more about Buddhism and the science behind meditation. I'm still learning, so treat the next section as notes. [then Buddhism doctrine]
proposals.after:
Option A: keep.
Option B: ‘…once I read more about Buddhism. I'm still learning, so treat the next section as notes.’ — move science entirely to Takeaways.
Option C: split the bridge — short Buddhism lead-in here; science sentence at the start of the Wright paragraph only.
proposals.rationale: Right now the bridge promises science, then you get Four Noble Truths. Slight bait-and-switch.

locate.find: read more about Buddhism and the science behind meditation

proposals.summary: China paragraph — keep, cut, or one sentence?
proposals.before: Shanghai / bath house / maximum consumerism sits between Wright and the London checklist.
proposals.after:
Option A: keep (contrast is the point).
Option B: one sentence — ‘After the monastery, Shanghai felt like maximum consumerism (another post) — hard to keep a quiet routine.’
Option C: cut; London checklist can stand alone.
proposals.rationale: It's vivid, but it's the only non-monastery anecdote and it interrupts the mind → science → routine arc. Your call on whether the contrast earns its space.

proposals.before: He spent years there and reached enlightenment when he turned to mindfulness of the mind.
proposals.after:
Option A: keep (matches what the monk taught).
Option B: ‘…and, in the version we were taught, reached enlightenment when he turned to mindfulness of the mind.’
Option C: softer — ‘…and that’s when the breakthrough came, in the telling we got.’
proposals.rationale: You asked if it’s true. Historically debated; attributing it to the monastery’s teaching is the safest if you want accuracy without a lecture.

proposals.summary: Ready to merge soon, or one more polish pass?
proposals.before: Post is coherent: experience → practice → map → takeaways/lists.
proposals.after:
Option A: ship-shaped after r10 decisions — freeze prose, only fix bugs.
Option B: one more pass focused only on cutting ~10–15% (technique para + reading lists are the longest remaining blocks).
proposals.rationale: Holistic: the remaining risk is length/repetition, not missing content. Technique paragraph is still the densest mobile read.
